violet: us-west2a - tiny pods stuck on a few racks, eviction churn up ~0.8%. noticed after yesterday's rack-pin rollout.
diego: saw it too. warmnode handoff backlog + rack pins = micro-silos. attach latency p95 jumped 400ms -> 3.2s.
sam: Logs show conntrack GC spikes and NAT egress queuing in that AZ. Likely causing attach/detach jitter.
ovps-bot: Alert: scheduler.p99_latency_us-west2a > 1400ms
diego: Quick mitigation: add a temporary relaxer for pods annotated `infra/binpack_escape=true` to ignore rack hard-affinity for 40m. Scope: tiny-gang only.
violet: Good. Also drop warmpool attach timeout 30s -> 10s to clear handoff queue faster. Risk: higher coldstart churn.
sam: Canary plan: patch scheduler-configmap in us-west2a only, watch eviction-rate and p99 for 20m. Revert if eviction-rate > 0.9% or egress delta > 6%.
diego: Patch I'll run: ```kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n infra --type merge --patch '{"data":{"enable_relax_escape":"true","relax_ttl":"40m","attach_timeout":"10s"}}'```
ops-bot: Runbook check: CI green required + oncall ack.
violet: CI green. Oncall acked. Starting canary.
ops-bot: Canary deployed by diego at 1811110018. Monitoring started.
sam: 7m update: p99 down 1.5s -> 0.7s, evictions 0.8% -> 0.2%. egress estimate +1.9%.
violet: Signal looks good. Keep for 30m then decide promote. Make ticket to gate future label rollouts on warmpool saturation metric.
ops-bot: Ticket SCHED-4999 created by violet
